mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with hydrochlorothiazide can cause hypertensive crisis due to sympathomimetic effects and potential additive blood pressure elevation; hydrochlorothiazide may also cause hypokalemia which increases cardiac arrhythmia risk in patients on MAOIs.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use alternative antihypertensive agents; monitor blood pressure closely and ensure patient awareness of dietary tyramine restrictions.
